comment: Ticketed exemptions for the declared-policy -> handler-enforcement lockstep gate (TestDeclaredPolicyEnforcedInLockstep, rpc_policy_lockstep_test.go). Every entry needs a procedure, a reason, and a ticket. An optional "missing" list narrows the exemption to specific floor capabilities so the rest of the declared floor stays enforced; omit it to exempt the whole procedure. Removing an entry re-arms the gate; adding one is a reviewable event. Mirrors module/tools/authz-coverage-allowlist.json.

enforcement.reason: Legacy read-only stub. Enforces the SUPER_ADMIN floor via an inline service.Store().GetPlatformRole compare instead of requirePlatformRole, so the require*-based scanner cannot see it; the check is present and denies non-super-admins.

Declares tenant ORG_ADMIN + billing:write, but requireBillingAdmin admits org admin/owner OR a plain member holding billing:write. That OR cannot be expressed by the flat IDL (which reads as AND), and the permission dimension the handler leans on is not modeled by this gate; the org-admin floor is intentionally looser than declared. Membership and the RECENT_STEP_UP MFA floor are still lockstep-enforced. Folding this into the central check waits on the #447 declaration/handler OR-parity work.

Declares tenant ORG_ADMIN with a TEAM resource binding, but requireTeamAdmin admits org admin/owner OR the team's own admin/owner (a plain org member). That OR cannot be expressed by the flat IDL; org membership and team scope are still lockstep-enforced. Folding waits on the #447 OR-parity work.
